lines.text_en: I'm afraid your flight was overbooked.
You're kidding. I booked at the last minute as it is.
lines.translation_ru: Да вы издеваетесь. Я и так бронировал в последний момент.
accepted: You're kidding. I booked at the last minute as it is.
You're kidding. I booked at the last minute.

lines.text_en: There's a red-eye tonight. It won't break the bank.
lines.translation_ru: Есть ночной рейс сегодня. Он не разорит вас.

lines.text_en: Fine, I'll bite the bullet. Better safe than sorry.
lines.translation_ru: Ладно, соберусь с духом. Лучше перестраховаться.
accepted: Fine, I'll bite the bullet. Better safe than sorry.

lines.text_en: Keep an eye on the gate board. It changes around the corner.
lines.translation_ru: Следите за табло. Оно вот-вот обновится.

lines.text_en: Got it. This trip has hit a snag, but let's hit the road anyway.
lines.translation_ru: Понял. Поездка пошла наперекосяк, но всё равно двинемся в путь.
accepted: Got it. This trip has hit a snag, but let's hit the road anyway.
Got it. Let's hit the road anyway.

lines.text_en: How was the city? Did it grow on you?
lines.translation_ru: Как вам город? Пришёлся по душе?

lines.text_en: Honestly, it's grown on me. Total culture shock at first.
lines.translation_ru: Честно, он мне понравился со временем. Сначала был полный культурный шок.
accepted: Honestly, it's grown on me. Total culture shock at first.
It's grown on me. Total culture shock at first.

lines.text_en: You look worn out. Jet lag, I bet.
lines.translation_ru: Вы выглядите уставшим. Ставку делаю, джетлаг.

lines.text_en: Exactly. I'm a bit under the weather, but it's part of the fun.
lines.translation_ru: Точно. Я немного неважно себя чувствую, но в этом часть удовольствия.
accepted: Exactly. I'm a bit under the weather, but it's part of the fun.
Exactly. I'm a bit under the weather.

lines.text_en: Should we call it a day, then?
Sounds like a plan. It was a once-in-a-lifetime trip.
lines.translation_ru: Звучит как план. Это была поездка раз в жизни.
accepted: Sounds like a plan. It was a once-in-a-lifetime trip.
